subject: Update module api and variable to valkey accordingly. (#455)
reason: The change is a pure mechanical rename inside src/module.c: the private struct field ValkeyModuleCommand->rediscmd becomes serverCmd, two static functions (freeRedisModuleAsyncRMCallPromise, flushRedisModuleIOBuffer) are renamed with their call sites, and two comments swap 'Redis' for 'Valkey'. Every changed line is a rename or comment edit with identical semantics; no reply, module ABI, persistence format, replication path or config is affected, so there is no runtime behaviour to exercise and no scenario is needed.
